usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank euro reference rate (USD)
usdRate.note: EUR 1 = USD 1.1172 on 30 October 2026 (ECB data portal EXR.D.USD.EUR.SP00.A), so about EUR 0.895 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 0.885.

inflation_cpi.note: CPI 5.0% year on year in September 2026 (3.8% in August), released 9 October 2026; secondary source because statistics.gr was not reachable. HICP averaged 2.9% in 2025 (ECB).

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% medium-term target; Greek HICP 2021-2025 average 4.0% (ECB ICP); CPI 5.0% in September 2026
inflation_projection.note: The ECB 2% target anchors euro-area inflation over the long run, but Greek inflation has run above the euro average (5.0% in September 2026), so 2.5% is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank, key ECB interest rates (deposit facility)
policy_rate.note: Greece uses the euro; ECB deposit facility rate 2.50% since 16 September 2026, still 2.50% on 31 October 2026 (ECB data portal FM.D.U2.EUR.4F.KR.DFR.LEV).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Greek banks, overnight deposits from households (new business)
savings_account_rate.note: Average rate on household overnight deposits in Greece was 0.03% every month from April to September 2026.

fdr_3m_rate.note: ECB/Bank of Greece MFI statistics publish household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year as one bucket (1.28% in September 2026); no separate 3-month rate found and bankofgreece.gr refused automated access.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Greek banks, household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Bucket covers all fixed terms up to one year: 1.28% in September 2026 (1.17% in August).

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring-deposit product with a published average rate was found for Greece.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Greek banks, household deposits with agreed maturity (outstanding amounts)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate on all outstanding household term deposits in September 2026 (1.19% in August); overnight deposits paid 0.03%. World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no Greece figure.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Greece has no government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals; individuals buy ordinary Greek government bonds and treasury bills through banks.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Greece 3-month government bill yield
tbill_91d_rate.note: Secondary-market 3-month yield on the Greece bond page (1-month 2.68%, 6-month 2.82%); the Public Debt Management Agency auctions 13-week treasury bills.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year Greek government bond yield found: Trading Economics shows no 5-year series for Greece, worldgovernmentbonds.com loads by script and bankofgreece.gr refused automated access.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Greece 10-year government bond yield
tbond_10y_rate.note: Page shows 4.32% (summary 4.35%); ECB long-term (10-year) convergence yield for Greece was 4.22% in September 2026.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Greece income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest is subject to 15% withholding tax, which fully settles the tax for individuals.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Greece income determination
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No savings certificate exists; PwC states that interest on bond loans and promissory notes of the Greek State acquired by individuals is exempt from income tax.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Hellenic Deposit and Investment Guarantee Fund (TEKE); European Commission, deposit guarantee schemes
deposit_insurance_limit.note: EUR 100,000 per depositor per bank under the EU Deposit Guarantee Schemes Directive, paid by TEKE in Greece; teke.gr did not show the figure to automated access.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Greek banks, extended credit card credit to households (new business)
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Typical rate, not a legal cap: average 16.88% on extended credit card debt in September 2026 (16.87% in August).

equity_return_low.sourceName: Athens General index 2,619 on 30 Oct 2026, up about 30% in a year but still 60% below its 1999 high; after-tax 1-year deposit 1.1%
equity_return_low.note: Low case: Greek shares repeat a long flat stretch like 2000-2020 and earn little more than safe instruments.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Athens General index (Trading Economics); tax-free 3-month treasury bill 2.76%
equity_return_base.note: Base case capped near the tax-free bill rate plus about 3 points because the Greek index has a weak 25-year record despite its strong recovery since 2016.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Athens General index (Trading Economics); global equity long-run returns
equity_return_high.note: High case: a diversified euro equity fund matching long-run global equity returns of about 7-8% in euros.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, 31% below the January 2026 high
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold barely keeps up after the 2025-26 spike, with no help from the euro.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); ECB 2% inflation target
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises roughly with world inflation plus a little, and the euro is assumed stable against the dollar over the long run.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in euro terms.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 1.28% (September 2026) less 15% withholding = 1.1% (ECB MFI statistics)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: after-tax term deposits only.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of after-tax term deposits and tax-exempt Greek treasury bills, kept below the bill rate.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Greece 10-year government bond 4.32%, tax-exempt for individuals
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: holding Greek government bonds, whose interest is tax-free, with some price risk.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Neither the Bank of Greece insurance supervision department nor the Hellenic Association of Insurance Companies publishes an industry life claim settlement ratio that could be found; bankofgreece.gr refused automated access.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold in Greece, but no published premium table or regulator premium data per sum insured was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Public hospital care is covered by EOPYY; no official figure for a typical out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Private health insurance is sold in Greece, but no published premium table per EUR 100,000 of cover was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending was 34.3% of current health expenditure in 2023, among the highest in the EU (latest available; older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP Greece, health: 0.4% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_health.note: Measured health prices have been held down by regulated prices, but private care costs tend to rise faster than general prices, so 3% is used for planning.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP Greece, education: 2.8% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices (mainly private tutoring and schools; public education is free) rose 2.8% in 2025; 3% is used for planning.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_expectancy.note: Men 79.9, women 84.7 (UN WPP estimate for 2026); World Bank 2024 figure 81.8.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 38.9 (2025, World Bank), 53.5 (2040) and 59.8 (2065, populationpyramid.net/greece/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Greece (July 2026)
retirement_age_default.note: General pension age 67 with at least 15 insurance years (4,500 days); a full pension is also payable from 62 with 40 insurance years. The July 2026 guide gives no later age for younger cohorts, so 67 is used for people born after 1975 (it may be raised in future if Greece applies its life-expectancy link).

retirement_age_government.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Greece (July 2026)
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants are insured with e-EFKA under the same unified rules since 2017, so the general age limit of 67 (62 with 40 years) applies.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 1.28% (September 2026) less 15% withholding = 1.1% (ECB MFI statistics)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: after-tax term deposits only.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of term deposits and tax-exempt treasury bills, kept well below the bill rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Greece 10-year government bond 4.32%, tax-exempt for individuals
retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of tax-exempt Greek government bonds, below the 10-year yield to allow for reinvestment risk.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: After-tax 1-year deposit 1.1%; Athens General record (Trading Economics)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 5.5% and half safe fixed income at about 1.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: OPEKA, social solidarity allowance for uninsured elderly (FAQ)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: EUR 418.95 a month (the eligibility section of the same page still shows the earlier EUR 409.13; the July 2026 EC guide gives EUR 399.54 and 418.95 in different places).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: OPEKA, social solidarity allowance for uninsured elderly
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Age 67, 20 years of permanent legal residence in Greece, no pension from Greece or abroad, and annual taxable income up to EUR 4,320 (single) or EUR 8,640 (couple).

gratuity_rule.note: Greek law gives severance on dismissal (scaled by length of service) and a reduced retirement severance (40% of the dismissal amount) under Law 2112/1920 as amended, not a fixed days-per-year gratuity; no source stating the current scale was read.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Greece (July 2026)
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory e-EFKA pension: a tax-funded national pension (EUR 446.87 a month with 20 insurance years) plus a contributory part; pensions are taxed as income (only those of people with 80%+ disability are exempt). Yearly increases follow Law 4387/2016 (half GDP growth plus half CPI, at most CPI), which is not described in the guide.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring-deposit product was found; regular saving usually goes into savings accounts or monthly mutual fund plans.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Greece has no retail savings certificate; individuals can buy Greek government bonds and treasury bills through banks, with interest exempt from income tax.

tbill_91d.note: 13-week bills auctioned by the Public Debt Management Agency; individuals buy through banks.

equity_fund.note: Retail mutual funds and exchange-traded index funds are widely available.

gold.note: Buying physical gold is legal; gold sovereigns are a traditional savings form in Greece.

centralBank.name: Bank of Greece
centralBank.note: Part of the Eurosystem; monetary policy set by the European Central Bank.

insuranceRegulator.name: Bank of Greece, Department of Private Insurance Supervision

insuranceComplaints.name: Hellenic Consumer Ombudsman
insuranceComplaints.note: Independent authority for consumer disputes, including with insurers; complaints can also be sent to the Bank of Greece insurance supervision department.

oldAgeAllowance.name: OPEKA, social solidarity allowance for uninsured elderly

publicHealthCover.name: EOPYY (National Organisation for the Provision of Health Services)

depositInsurance.name: Hellenic Deposit and Investment Guarantee Fund (TEKE)
